text_block_list.text:
One day off.
While walking along the riverbed――

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... So tireeeddd~~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Let's take a break for a bit.
We both have races coming up soon, so overdoing it is strictly off-limits.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... up until a moment ago,
this wasn't the plan at all, but――

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ That wraps it up for today.
Did I push myself too hard just because my next race is against tough competition~...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Hm... That voice is――

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
As I suspected, it is you, Nature-san.
Could it be that you are heading back to the dormitory?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Tahaha. I broke a sweat from a light run...
Self-training really isn't my thing after all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
However, I cannot permit you to enter the dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Why not?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That is, well...
Due to unavoidable circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno~! Turbo's starviiing~~!
I can't wait any longer!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Wait, it's Natureee~~?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...! It was worth the wait, was it not, Turbo-san?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Mnh?! Shellfish* worth waiting for...?
Turbo loves scallops best!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes... you clammed up and waited patiently like a shellfish, did you not?
To run alongside Nature-san. The entire time.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... That's right! I waited like a scallop!
Nature, let's raceee~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, look, I just got back from self-train――
Ugh... don't look at me with those eyes~~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
――And that's how we ended up here.
Well, it turned out to be good race prep, though.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right! Turbo's prep is complete too!
Nature, let's head backeeer!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?! Now we're running back?!
Whoa, full-throttle Turbo as always, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait a minute, someone's in front of the dorm again?
What is it this timeee...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, aren't those the kids
from the volunteer work! Huh, what's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Children
text_block_list.text:
Ready, set! Welcome!
To the "Nature-oneechan Cheering Party"!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Horse Girl Child
text_block_list.text:
You see! We heard that you're running against
super-fast girls in your next race, Onee-chan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So everyone wanted to cheer you on...
and worked super hard preparing this party, you see!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Party... preparations...
Then earlier, not letting me into the dorm was――

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Cooperating to stall you.
We share the exact same sentiments as these children, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san... We are well aware.
Of the effort you put in every single day leading up to the race.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! You looked at the roster for your next race
and laughed it off saying, "No way I can win this~", but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hold on... my brain can't... wait,
you guys knew about my extra practice this whole time... E-Ehhhh~...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
............*siiiiigh*.
Instead of 'great', shouldn't you call them overly meddlesome?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Going this far just for my sake...
When people do stuff like this, even I...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...can't help but think about winning, you know!
It's totally out of character for meee... Jeeez!

Contrary to her grumbling, Nice Nature wore a smile
as she headed into the party.
Thanks to their cheers, she seemed more motivated than ever.
